old_note: *And the god of that world will stretch forth his hand against the Son, and they will crucify Him on a tree, and will slay Him not knowing who He is.* Ascension of Isaiah 9:14 names THE direct external-witness verbal-anchor for the god-of-that-world-stretching-forth-his-hand-against-the-Son-and-they-will-crucify-Him-on-a-tree substance — the wisdom-stream had named the architecture of the world-rulers-and-their-rulers-not-knowing-who-the-Son-is at the heavenly-register. The framework reads the verse against Matt 27:35's *and they crucified him* — the operative-walking-out at the historical-pivot of the architecture Ascension of Isaiah had named centuries before at the wisdom-stream-witness. The framework reads the *not knowing who He is* substance in continuity with 1 Corinthians 2:8's *had they known it, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.* The framework reads the *crucify Him on a tree* substance in continuity with Devarim (Deuteronomy) 21:22-23 + Galatians 3:13's *cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree* — the King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) walks-the-curse-of-the-Deuteronomy-28-exile-judgment-substance the twelve-tribes-walked-substantively, as the Pesach (Passover)-lamb-substance, walking-out-the-substance the twelve-tribes-can-be-gathered-home-substantively per Red Line #4's reading (the curse is the exile-judgment, NOT the Torah; the King walks-the-curse, not the abolishing-of-the-Torah). Per Yoshi's S32 sourcing-decision (api/seed.py:EDITION_PROFILES["ascension-isaiah"]), AI is the *first witness* aligning with the framework's Formless-Father / Formed-of-the-Formless nature-of-God teaching — pre-Nicene, late-1st / early-2nd CE. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.

old_note: *And I saw how He ascended into the seventh heaven, and all the righteous and all the angels praised Him. And then I saw Him sit down on the right hand of that Great Glory whose glory I told you that I could not behold.* Ascension of Isaiah 11:32 names THE direct external-witness verbal-anchor for the King's-Ascension-to-the-right-hand-of-the-Great-Glory substance — the operative-substance of Psalm 110:1's *Yahuah (the LORD) said unto my Adon (Lord), Sit thou at my right hand* the prophet-David walked at the Tanakh-register. The framework reads the verse against Matt 28:18's *All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.* The substantial-Great-Glory at AI 11:32 is the Father — the Formless-Source per the framework's nature-of-God reading per Red Line #10; the substantial-right-hand-of-the-Great-Glory is the place from-which the King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) walks-the-Daniel-7:13-14 dominion-and-glory-and-a-kingdom-substance. The substantial-substance is the Father-Son-relational-architecture-substance — NOT-categorical-three-co-equal-persons-Trinitarian-substance the inherited-Christian-Nicene-Constantinople-collapse walks. The King's *all power is given unto me* names the Father-giving-the-Son the everlasting-dominion the prophet-Daniel walked at Daniel 7:14; AI 11:32 names the heavenly-vision-substance the gospel-substance enacts at the historical-pivot. The framework reads this in continuity with Philippians 2:9-11 (*Elohim (God) also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name*). FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.

old_note: *And I saw him descend into the Holy of Holies, and take from thence the veil, and the holy ark, and the mercy-seat, and the two tables, and the holy raiment of the priests, and the altar of incense, and the forty-eight precious stones, wherewith the priest was adorned and all the holy vessels of the tabernacle.* 2 Baruch (Charles edition seq #3, verse 7; standard 2 Baruch 6:7) names the wisdom-stream's direct external-witness articulation of the heavenly-angel-descending-into-the-Holy-of-Holies-and-taking-the-veil substance — the wisdom-stream had named the veil-architecture at the heavenly-register (the angel-from-above acting upon the veil), and Matt 27:51's *the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom* names the operative-fulfillment at the earthly-pivot. The framework reads the verses together: the *from the top to the bottom* direction names the Father-from-above tearing-the-veil-from-the-heavenly-side, opening-the-way-back-into-the-Most-Holy-Place per Hebrews 10:19-22's *boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Yahusha (Jesus), by a new and living way, which he hath consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh.* This is the door-home opening architecturally per the *Grace, the Way, the New Heart, and the Mercy of Depart* exposition in framework-deep.md — grace as the means of return-to-the-Father's-house, NOT the inherited-Christian-replacement-theology reading that the temple-system-is-now-replaced-by-the-church (the framework rejects the abolition-of-the-Father's-house reading; the framework reads the veil-rent as Yahuah-opening-the-Way-back-into-the-Father's-house, not as Yahuah-abolishing-the-Father's-house). FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.

old_note: *But those who have been saved by their works, And to whom the law has been now a hope, And understanding an expectation, And wisdom a confidence, Shall wonders appear in their time. For they shall behold the world which is now invisible to them, And they shall behold the time which is now hidden from them.* 2 Baruch (Charles edition seq #21, verse 1; standard 2 Baruch 51:1-8) names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the saved-by-their-works-shall-behold-the-world-now-invisible substance — the apocalyptic-stream's resurrection-glory architecture. The framework reads the verse against Matt 27:52-53's *and the graves were opened; and many bodies of the saints which slept arose, and came out of the graves after his resurrection, and went into the holy city, and appeared unto many* — the saints-arising-and-appearing-in-the-holy-city substance is the historical-pivot-foretaste of the broader-architecture 2 Baruch 51 names: the faithful-righteous-shall-behold-the-world-now-invisible + shall-be-made-like-unto-the-angels + shall-be-equal-to-the-stars. The framework reads the saved-by-their-works language CAREFULLY — NOT the inherited-Reformation-merit-doctrine collapse; the framework reads works as the fruit-of-the-Spirit-internalized-Torah per Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 36:26-27 + Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 31:31-34 + James 2:14-26's *faith without works is dead*; the works are the Spirit-empowered-walking-in-the-Way the framework's *Grace, the Way, the New Heart, and the Mercy of Depart* exposition unfolds. The wisdom-stream had named the architecture-of-the-resurrection-glory; the saints-arising-at-the-cross substance is the historical-foretaste.
